localizedText.zh-CN: 生成.NET XML及配置驱动文档
localizedText.en: Generate .NET XML and configuration-driven documentation

localizedText.zh-CN: 从显式XML输入或JSON配置生成.NET文档工件及结果清单。
localizedText.en: Generate .NET documentation artifacts and a result manifest from explicit XML inputs or JSON configuration.

localizedText.zh-CN: hia-dotnetdoc --config dotnetdoc.config.json
localizedText.en: hia-dotnetdoc --config dotnetdoc.config.json

localizedText.zh-CN: dotnetdoc与hia-dotnetdoc是同一实现的等价调用名，帮助展示规范入口。
localizedText.en: dotnetdoc and hia-dotnetdoc are equivalent names for one implementation; help displays the canonical entry.

localizedText.zh-CN: 配置模式仅非空out-dir覆盖输出；空字符串保留配置。
localizedText.en: In config mode only a nonempty out-dir overrides output; an empty string retains the configuration.

localizedText.zh-CN: workspace-root、title及XML位置输入仅用于直接模式，配置模式忽略。
localizedText.en: workspace-root, title and positional XML inputs apply only to direct mode and are ignored in config mode.

localizedText.zh-CN: 配置路径相对调用目录，配置工作区相对配置目录；直接工作区相对调用目录，输出相对工作区。
localizedText.en: Config paths use cwd and configured workspaces use the config directory; direct workspaces use cwd and output uses the workspace.

localizedText.zh-CN: 运行会创建目录、覆盖工件并写结果清单；partial或failed可能保留已成功写入。
localizedText.en: Runs create directories, replace artifacts and write a result manifest; partial or failed results may retain successful writes.

localizedText.zh-CN: Node严格解析先于帮助，未知开关或缺值返回1；重复带值选项取末值，--后作为XML位置输入。
localizedText.en: Node strict parsing precedes help; unknown switches or missing values exit 1. Repeated value options use the last value, and tokens after -- are positional XML inputs.

localizedText.zh-CN: 纯XML抽取无需SDK。配置中的C#抽取或项目源码解析使用.NET10 SDK/helper，其构建可能按SDK设置进行还原及工作负载清单下载。
localizedText.en: Plain XML extraction needs no SDK. Configured C# extraction or project source resolution uses the .NET 10 SDK/helper; its build may restore dependencies or download workload manifests according to SDK settings.

localizedText.en: Output is workspace-relative and defaults to dist/dotnetdoc in direct mode; an empty direct-mode string selects the workspace root.

localizedText.en: Direct mode resolves from cwd and defaults to cwd; ignored in config mode.

localizedText.en: Direct mode only, giving every XML input the same title; omission uses adapter defaults and config mode ignores it.

localizedText.en: Direct mode requires at least one workspace-relative XML input; ignored in config mode.
